name: French Omelet
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Beat eggs slightly, just enough to blend yolks and whites.
Put butter in hot omelet pan; when melted, turn in the mixture.
As it cooks, prick and pick up with a fork until the whole is of creamy consistency.
Place on hotter part of range that it may brown quickly underneath.
Fold, and turn on hot platter.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat eggs slightly, just enough to blend yolks and whites.
2. Add the milk and seasonings.
3. Put butter in hot omelet pan; when melted, turn in the mixture.
4. As it cooks, prick and pick up with a fork until the whole is of creamy consistency.
5. Place on hotter part of range that it may brown quickly underneath.
6. Fold, and turn on hot platter.
